S0868.L3t: To achieve a 90% confidence interval with width at most 0.08, the required sample size is calculated using the formula n = (z*σ/E)^2, where z* is the critical value for 90% confidence, σ is the standard deviation (maximized at 0.5 for proportions), and E is the margin of error (half the width).
S0868.L3f: A sample size of about 27 is sufficient because the width of the confidence interval is directly proportional to the sample size, so a small sample will yield a narrow interval.
